scope: Actual original World methods and callbacks. Authored equipment slots, warrior/magician, local/guest seats, and a separately identified synthetic masked container registered through the original extension API. Foreign Reliquary views deliberately populated to test authority before mutation.

coverageRevision.reason: Added explicit full-container ordering and Reliquary move authority/callback cases before acceptance. Earlier draft retained locally; no accepted fixture replaced.

observedLaws: Invalid/disabled/incompatible requested equipment slots fall back to the first enabled compatible slot, preferring an empty one.
Displaced worn gear returns through a compatible source slot, then the bag, then host ground delivery.
Failed generic-container first-fit placement and failed take can reorder their source arrays. Preserve order effects because downstream folds may observe them.
Same-cell bag/container moves still invoke their original dirty/recalculation callbacks.
limits: Trusted host state and synchronous read ports; not a network or durable-transaction proof.
A synthetic container exercises the existing extension contract; it is not new shipped game content.
No native-engine or hardware performance claim.
